@Criptoit @dogecoin @dogecoin_devs @BillyM2k @langer_hans @JRossNicoll @ummjackson Hey! thanks for the question. Private keys are generating from the random seed phrase at the wallet start. Keys are encrypted and never leave your device. Transaction is signed on your device before the broadcasting to blockchain nodes.

@ummjackson @gladkos @dogecoin @dogecoin_devs @BillyM2k @langer_hans @JRossNicoll @Changelly_team Hey Jackson, thanks for the question! We don't have servers. Atomic swaps are onchain.
